purpose: Join formal RedSARA/AGE filings, later Ministerio Fiscal email events and prosecution-side responses without collapsing evidential meaning, procedural identity or institutional numbering.
governing_rules: A RedSARA/AGE receipt proves presentation or receipt only to the extent recorded; it does not prove merits, investigation, adoption, agreement or truth.
A sent email is not a formal RedSARA filing unless a corresponding formal receipt is independently identified.
DRAFT items are excluded from sent/received denominators.
SELF_ARCHIVE items are provenance only and are not delivery evidence.
An incoming acknowledgement, decree or routing communication is response-side evidence and must not be counted as a claimant filing.
Duplicates, corrections and controlling-version messages must be linked and must not inflate substantive-event counts.
The same numeric expediente reference must not be treated as the same proceeding when the organ, source fingerprint or source content differs.
The same filename is not file identity; byte identity requires a cryptographic hash match.
Routing or incorporation instructions are not merits acceptance, opening of an investigation, a finding or proof of criminal conduct.

reference_identity_controls.reason: Two three-page official-source records use the short reference 745/2026 and the same filename but have different byte fingerprints, organs/context and operative content. Numeric reference and filename therefore cannot be used as identity keys.

records.controlled_public_summary: Existing Inspection-specific dossier records an archive decree notified 26 August 2026 and a separate review/preservation track.
records.boundary: No inference is made that this source is identical to the Las Palmas Provincial Prosecutor source below.

controlled_source_summary: The official document states that six writings received on 13, 17 and 20 August 2026 were referred to the Special Anti-Corruption Prosecutor so that they could be incorporated into ET 46/2025.
It separately states that a writing received on 10 August 2026 under REGAGE 26e00079131250 was referred on 11 August to the Arrecife Area Prosecutor for DI 22/2026.
The decree references an earlier 20 April registration REGAGE 26e00036156931 and a 2 July registration REGAGE 26e00058990118 in the prior referral context.

The operative part orders referral of the six writings for incorporation into ET 46/2025 and notification to the complainant; the governmental file is then archived in that administrative/routing sense.
records.privacy: No personal identifiers, signature certificate identifiers, address, email or phone are reproduced in the public derivative.
records.boundary: Referral/incorporation instruction does not by itself establish merits examination, investigation opening, adoption of allegations, agreement, criminal characterisation or guilt.

reference_identity_controls.resolution_rule: Use organ + date + source hash + source-bound identifier. Never collapse records solely because both say 745/2026 or use the same filename.
